title.zh: 查看当前账号下的邀请记录

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，查询当前管理账号`172841235500****`的邀请记录。
descriptions.en: This topic provides an example on how to call the API operation to query the invitations that are associated with the management account `172841235500****`. The response shows that two invitations are associated with the management account.
